description: A React component class for rendering charts in Apache Superset, including handling loading states, errors, and rendering chart content via ChartRenderer.

classes.name: Chart
classes.description: A React component for rendering and managing chart visualization, including error handling, loading states, and query management.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Triggers a chart data query if 'triggerQuery' prop is true upon component mount.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Triggers a chart data query if 'triggerQuery' prop is true upon component update.

methods.name: shouldRenderChart
methods.description: Determines if the chart should be rendered based on view state, feature flags, and user agent.

methods.name: runQuery
methods.description: Dispatches a request to fetch chart data, considering feature flags and override URL parameters.

methods.name: handleRenderContainerFailure
methods.description: Handles errors during chart rendering, logs warnings, and updates chart rendering failure state.

methods.name: renderErrorMessage
methods.description: Renders appropriate error messages or loading states based on query response and datasource status.

methods.name: renderSpinner
methods.description: Displays a loading spinner with a message indicating waiting on database or database name.

methods.name: renderChartContainer
methods.description: Renders the chart visualization via ChartRenderer or a loading indicator.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main render method managing different states: loading, error, empty, or chart display.
